title: Core: Hit test improvements (polygon collision)
description: Improve packages/core/src/engine/hittest.ts hitTestPoint to use actual polygon ray-casting for ShapeDisplayObjects instead of just AABB. For a ShapePath with line segments, use point-in-polygon ray casting. For text and symbol instances, keep AABB. Tests: a point inside a triangle returns true, a point outside returns false, a point on the edge returns correct result.
